lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都倒了
lines.en: The grass falls where I pass
My mouth hangs open, toothless
Every step lands light
I walk the edge of the waste
I raise my head and my throat works
I go toward whatever sounds
Ash drifts where I've been
I keep my body low
I cross a stretch of dead grass
I come on, a step at a time
I stop at the edge of a crack
I turn my head away, then back
I stand, and my throat swells
The air tightens around me
I listen, very carefully

lines.zh: 我的影子不动，我也不动
lines.en: My shadow doesn't move, and neither do I
I open my mouth and breathe in slowly
This land will do
The hide on my back shivers
The distant birds have all gone
I wait for a single sound

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，可我知道你在哪
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I know where you are
You're in front of me; good
Hold still; let me line up
That humming inside your ears
My throat is sounding
You cover your ears, too late
Only air between us
You back behind a stone
Stone doesn't stop sound
I smile, without a sound
It hurts your ears, doesn't it
My sound cuts out
I step back, my throat tight
I clap a hand over my mouth
A split opens in my hide
I stop and draw breath again
I made no sound at all
I tip to one side
The ground splits under me
I stare at you, though I can't see
I begin to draw back by inches
You're talking; good
Sound; I want more sound
Strike that iron once
Give me the thing that rings

lines.zh: 我听见了它，很远就听见
lines.en: I heard it from far off
Lift it up
Sound gives me direction
Shout once more
My neck stretches out, waiting
That's good, but not enough
You hit me and the sound bursts

lines.zh: 我退了半步，喉咙还在响
lines.en: I step back, my throat still sounding
You squeeze past me

lines.zh: 我被撞得后退，尾巴扫过枯枝。
lines.en: Knocked back, my tail sweeps through dead branches.

lines.zh: 我的身子很轻，可我不让
lines.en: I'm light, but I won't yield
You pull me and we spin together

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我声音断了
lines.en: The bump cuts my sound off

lines.zh: 我贴着枯树，才没被推倒。
lines.en: I cling to a dead tree and keep my feet.
You pull back and I draw breath again
The ground has opened in lines
The same sound comes from far off
Our frequencies meet
It's older, and its sound is lower

lines.zh: 我的声波，两张嘴一起放。
lines.en: Two mouths release my sound wave.
Every leaf on the tree falls

lines.zh: 它靠过来，喉咙贴着我的
lines.en: It leans in, throat against mine
The ground cracks under us both
We need nothing else
This sound will carry far
More will come, following it
I pick it up and it rings
I squeeze it, wanting it to ring again
It tastes of iron
I hold it to my throat
Its sound carries a long way
I set it down and it's still ringing
That sound is wrong
I'll keep it as a marker
My voice cracks it
I crush it into a lump
You moved, and the sound came out
I turn my head and line up
You want to hide, but I can hear

lines.zh: 这片地会把声音送给我
lines.en: This land carries sound to me
You have a little time left
I've drawn a deep breath

lines.zh: 你听见那个嗡嗡声了吗
lines.en: Do you hear that hum
The sound is rising
Covering your ears won't help

lines.zh: 这一片石头会把声音折回来
lines.en: These stones will fold the sound back
You'll hear it twice
I've fixed your position by sound
I wait for the best distance
Don't run; the sound will find you
I've already begun
My mouth is open and my air is full
My mouth is open, my throat swelling
The waves go out one after another

lines.zh: 你捂住了耳朵，还是站不稳
lines.en: You cover your ears and still stagger

lines.zh: 石头把声音折回来，我听见
lines.en: The stones fold it back, and I hear

lines.zh: 你换了位置，声波追过去
lines.en: You move, and the wave follows

lines.zh: 我停了一下，再吸一口气
lines.en: I pause and draw another breath
Coming closer only makes it worse
My voice is climbing
Bark falls off the trees in pieces
You've backed into the open

lines.zh: 开阔的地方没有回声挡着
lines.en: The open has no echo to shield you

lines.zh: 你听见的第二次比第一次响
lines.en: The second you hear is louder than the first
A crack opens at my feet
Don't stand straight; it'll be a little better
But only a little
I'm waiting for the air to run out
You're still standing; I'm satisfied
The next round will be stronger
Don't count on me stopping
I take one more step in

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，一波声浪撞过去
lines.en: I open my mouth and a wave slams into you

lines.zh: 你被震得后退，鼻子流血
lines.en: The shock knocks you back, blood at your nose

lines.zh: 我的声音贴着地面推过去
lines.en: My sound pushes along the ground

lines.zh: 你手一松，武器差点掉了
lines.en: Your grip loosens; the weapon nearly drops

lines.zh: 这一下把石头都震裂了
lines.en: That one cracks the stone
You charge; I slide in close

lines.zh: 我的喉咙抵住你的胸口
lines.en: My throat presses against your chest
You hear your own bones

lines.zh: 你打在我身上，我声音没断
lines.en: You hit me and my sound doesn't break
I retreat, and my mouth stays open
The wave makes your legs buckle
I've drawn another breath
This wave is closer and heavier
Stones fall from above
Flatten yourself and it'll be easier
I haven't stopped

lines.zh: 这一声几乎贴着你的耳朵
lines.en: This one lands right at your ear
The wave throws you into a tree
I hold for half a beat, then open my mouth
The distant echo helps me too
Ash rises over the waste
I rise up out of the ash

lines.zh: 空气先紧了，然后才是声音
lines.en: First the air tightens, then the sound
I stand with my mouth open, waiting for breath
The nearby stones start ringing

lines.zh: 这一片地方太空了，正合我
lines.en: This place is empty; it suits me
I try a small sound first
The grass droops at once
The cracks in the ground lengthen
I flatten my thin body
I know something living is near

lines.zh: 我转过头，对着你的方向
lines.en: I turn my head toward you
Fire takes me and I shriek

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，身子折了
lines.en: I fall and my body folds

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我的声音没了
lines.en: Water fills my throat and my sound goes
The blast scatters my waves
The arrow passes through and leaves a hole
Magic plugs my throat

lines.zh: 太久没有声音可听，我快撑不住
lines.en: Too long with no sound to hear; I'm failing

lines.zh: 雷声盖过我的，我一时听不见自己
lines.en: Thunder drowns mine and I can't hear myself

lines.zh: 这里没有能折声的东西
lines.en: Nothing here to fold the sound back
